meta.name: add-mattermost
meta.description: Add a self-hosted or cloud Mattermost bot channel through the Chat SDK bridge, reusing a healthy server when available and linking to official server setup guidance when needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Mattermost 机器人接进聊天频道,复用可用服务器并给出搭建指引
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你团队用 Mattermost,想让机器人常驻聊天频道。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team runs Mattermost and wants a bot living in its channels.

howto.what: 它给 Claude 接上 Mattermost 机器人频道,支持私聊、频道、线程、文件和审批卡片;先探测已有服务器让你选,再引导填写机器人令牌、回调地址,并构建、测试、重启。
howto.when: 当你想让 Claude 接入 Mattermost,或要求添加 Mattermost 频道时触发;流程先探测本地或已有服务器(如 localhost:8065),由你选定后再继续。

say.text: 帮我接入 Mattermost,先看看有没有现成的服务器
say.note: 会探测本地 8065 等地址,列出结果让你选

say.text: 用 use,就选探测到的那台服务器
say.note: 直接复用探测到的服务器,不再手填

howto.what_en: Connects Claude to a Mattermost bot channel with DMs, channels, threads, files, reactions and approval cards: probes for an existing server, asks you to pick one, then guides bot token and callback setup, build, test and restart.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Mattermost channel to Claude; it starts by probing local or existing servers (e.g. localhost:8065) and asking you to select one.

say_en.text: Connect me to Mattermost; first check if a server already exists
say_en.note: Probes local ports such as 8065 and lists what it finds
Sets that URL as the canonical base URL and verifies it

say_en.text: Use it - go with the detected server
say_en.note: Reuses the detected server instead of typing a URL
